categories.main_business_segments: Dayu Irrigation Group primarily operates in the digital water conservancy industry, focusing on agricultural water-saving irrigation, rural water infrastructure, water resource management, and ecological environment services. The company is organized into four main business groups: Dayu Agricultural Water Group (engineering and infrastructure construction), Dayu Design Group (water conservancy design and consulting), Dayu Huitu Group (digital twin modeling, software and hardware development, water information integration), and Dayu Equipment Development Group (smart irrigation equipment manufacturing and sales). Their services cover planning, design, manufacturing, construction, digital intelligence, and operation and maintenance across the entire water and agricultural water sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as IoT, cloud computing, remote sensing, blockchain, big data, digital twin, and AI to integrate with traditional water conservancy. They develop smart irrigation equipment including intelligent metering and control devices, high-efficiency irrigation products, ecological environmental equipment, and regional sonic rain enhancement devices. Their software platforms include digital twin 3D visualization GIS, water resource scheduling models, and SaaS cloud products for water management. Production follows an order-driven, sales-forecast combined model with flexible factory deployment and strict supplier management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies at various levels responsible for water conservancy, agriculture, and rural infrastructure, as well as state-owned enterprises and private sector partners. The company serves markets related to agricultural irrigation, rural water supply, water resource management, ecological environment governance, and urban-rural integrated water services. Their projects support national strategies such as rural revitalization, food security, and high-standard farmland construction.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dayu Irrigation Group has a nationwide presence covering all provincial-level regions in China except Shanghai and Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. They have expanded into international markets with projects in over 60 countries including Vietnam, Uzbekistan, Cuba, Nigeria, Jamaica, South Africa, Thailand, Pakistan, Russia, and Croatia. The company has established global service networks and international cooperative research labs, notably with Kazakhstan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire supply chain of digital water conservancy, from upstream R&D and manufacturing of smart irrigation equipment, midstream design and engineering consulting, to downstream construction, project delivery, and long-term operation and maintenance services. They provide integrated solutions combining hardware, software, and services, positioning themselves as a full-cycle solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on digital transformation and smart water management, emphasizing R&D in digital twin technology, AI-enabled water resource scheduling, and smart irrigation equipment. They invest in developing SaaS platforms, intelligent control devices, and ecological water treatment technologies. The company also pursues innovation in business models integrating government and social capital, and aims to expand into new tech areas such as agricultural drones and unmanned equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of smart irrigation and water management products, engineering construction contracts (including EPC and EPC+O models), design and consulting services, software and system integration, and long-term operation and maintenance contracts. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and licensing of technology.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dayu Irrigation Group is a leading and influential player in China's digital water conservancy and agricultural water-saving industry. It holds a top market share among private enterprises and is recognized for its comprehensive industry chain layout and nationwide coverage. The company collaborates extensively with central and state-owned enterprises, research institutions, and international partners, maintaining a competitive edge through technological innovation and integrated service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 4.38 billion RMB, a 26.83% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 81.13 million RMB, up 61.81%. Total assets reached about 9.35 billion RMB, growing 17.53% from the previous year. The company has shown strong order intake, with new contracts totaling over 5.3 billion RMB, and improved cash flow from operations. It maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by national policy and capital market activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dayu Irrigation Group differentiates itself by offering comprehensive, integrated digital water conservancy solutions that combine advanced smart hardware, proprietary software platforms, and professional operation services. Their unique value lies in the full lifecycle management of water infrastructure projects, pioneering social capital participation models, and leading digital twin and AI applications in water resource management. The company emphasizes high-quality, efficient water-saving technologies and sustainable agricultural water management, supported by strong R&D capabilities and nationwide service networks.
